description: Regressioni sintetiche preregistrate: oggetto specifico, descrizioni neutre, ipotesi, problemi vissuti e risolti. Non sono dati raccolti né validazioni umane indipendenti.

topics.painPoint: I vasi per coltivare erbe sul balcone sono troppo costosi

cases.text: The planters for basil on my apartment balcony are too expensive for my budget.
The pruning shears I use for my balcony herbs are too expensive. The pots themselves are affordable.
A pack of three pots for my balcony herbs costs thirty dollars, which is ten dollars per pot.
I have not checked prices or bought herb planters; I am only guessing the balcony pots will cost too much.
Balcony herb planters used to be too expensive for me, but reusing old food containers solved my budget problem.

topics.painPoint: I pennelli per acquerello perdono setole durante l'uso

cases.text: When I paint with watercolors, bristles fall out of my brush every time I wet it.
My watercolor paper sheds fibers when wet. My brushes do not lose bristles.
My watercolor brushes come in packs of two and have synthetic bristles.
I have never used this watercolor brush; I only suspect that its bristles will fall out.
My old watercolor brush kept losing bristles; replacing it with a better one solved that problem.

topics.painPoint: Le istruzioni per raggruppare righe con pandas groupby sono difficili da comprendere

cases.text: I cannot understand the pandas groupby instructions for grouping rows in my CSV dataset.
I understand pandas groupby, but the histogram plotting tutorial is impossible for me to follow.
The pandas groupby documentation has a section on grouping rows by column values.
I have not read the groupby tutorial yet; I am only guessing that its instructions will be confusing.
I could not understand pandas groupby until a worked CSV example explained it; that solved my confusion.

topics.painPoint: La crosta del pane a lievito madre fatto in casa è troppo dura da tagliare

cases.text: The crust of the sourdough bread I bake at home is so hard that I cannot slice it.
My sourdough starter is too thick to stir, but the crust of my baked loaves is easy to cut.
The crust of my homemade sourdough loaf is golden brown after baking.
I have never baked sourdough; I am only guessing that my first loaf will have a crust too hard to cut.
The crust of my homemade sourdough used to be too hard to slice, but adding steam fixed it.
